title: Nondeterministic precondition predicate
statement: Given a nondeterministic register program $A$, an input bit string $x$, and a register-machine configuration $a$, the predicate $\mathrm{NPreS}$ holds exactly when the deterministic program obtained from $A$ by replacing each choice with the answer $0$ satisfies $\mathrm{PreS}$ on input $x$ at configuration $a$.
